purpose: City-specific cadastral-source research; findings are limited to observed first-party evidence.
name: Musangala

queries.query: Musangala Democratic Republic of the Congo cadastral parcel map official
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the official Ministry of Land Affairs and Cadastre site, its cadastral-circumscriptions directory, the official land-record search procedure, and the BIC cadastral information portal. No Musangala-specific public parcel vector service or safe anonymous ID+geometry response was found.

queries.query: Musangala RDC cadastre parcelle carte officielle
queries.result: La recherche en français a retrouvé le Ministère des Affaires Foncières, l'annuaire officiel des circonscriptions foncières et cadastrales, la procédure officielle de demande de recherche foncière et le portail BIC. Aucun service public de parcelles pour Musangala ni réponse anonyme sûre avec identifiant et géométrie n'a été obtenu.

registryEvidence.custodian: Ministère des Affaires Foncières de la République démocratique du Congo; provincial/local cadastral custody is organized through listed circonscriptions foncières.
registryEvidence.locality: Musangala, Democratic Republic of the Congo; the exact WUP locality-to-circonscription mapping was not established.
registryEvidence.scopeNote: The official directory evidences the national/local cadastral administration and the official procedure evidences access through a Conservateur des Titres Immobiliers or Chef de Division du Cadastre. It does not establish a Musangala-local open parcel map or API.

parcelDiscovery.note: No safe anonymous parcel ID+geometry response was obtained. The exact WUP point was preserved in latitude/longitude order and was not shifted or used as an absence test.

requestOutcomes.outcome: Official Ministry homepage retrieved. It identifies cadastral/land-affairs functions and a pilot digitization project; no public parcel feature service was exposed.
Official cadastral-circumscriptions directory retrieved. It lists administrative land offices by province, but no Musangala parcel layer, viewer, schema, CRS, or geometry endpoint.

Official service description retrieved. It requires a formal request to the land-title registrar or cadastral division and concerns registry consultation; no anonymous geometry endpoint was exposed and no unsafe property query was made.
BIC public landing page retrieved. It advertises cadastral data and states service availability for Nord-Kivu and Sud-Kivu; Musangala is not shown as covered.
Current public map route retrieved. The viewer is an authentication-gated login/registration wall; no public map response, parcel schema, CRS, native identity, or geometry was obtained.

Current viewer JavaScript inspected. It references a public Supabase-backed application and parcel-related UI, but no safe anonymous parcel feature query for Musangala was exposed. No login, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or unsafe field request was attempted.

Bounded anonymous REST discovery using the viewer's public application configuration returned Invalid API key / service-role-only response; no schema or parcel geometry was obtained. No credential escalation or TLS exception was used.

schemaAndCrs.viewerConfig: BIC viewer JavaScript was inspected, but no usable anonymous parcel-layer configuration was obtained.

boundedAnonymousResponse.requestScope: No parcel feature query succeeded; exact WUP point [-10.3874908583713, 28.6117974652902] was preserved and not shifted.
boundedAnonymousResponse.result: No usable public feature-query response was obtained.

safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identity if publicly exposed and source-proven

qualification.reason: National/local cadastral custody is evidenced, but no anonymous source-native parcel geometry, schema, CRS, or stable native identity was qualified.

scopeLimits: A zero exact-point hit, map extent miss, timeout, login wall, unusable UI, or unavailable API is not evidence of citywide parcel absence.
The official evidence establishes the national custodian and formal registry procedure, not Musangala-local open geometry coverage.
No raw source-specific attribute sets, synthetic row identity, or GeoJSON sample was retained.
Packet completion is research completion only and is not source integration or admission.
uncertainty: The Ministry or a local cadastral circumscription may hold records for Musangala, but the responsible local office, current viewer/API route, CRS, native parcel identity, geometry access, and citywide coverage remain unverified.
